Night Drive

Night city, day city, a snowy mountain road or a drift park: drive the way you like. Up to 16 players.

PLAYERS
1–16
MODE
Party
PLATFORM
Browser · mobile and desktop
PRICE
Free, no account needed
Create a Night Drive room
Quick join
What is Night Drive?

Night Drive is a calm 3D driving experience for 1–16 players with four maps: Night City on an endless sodium-lit highway, Day City on the same road in daylight, a winding two-lane Mountain Road (snowy, rainy, foggy or clear) and a traffic-free Drift Park. Pick a sports car, a classic, a retro coupe, a sedan or a van; score with kilometres and close passes on the road, or by sliding sideways on the drift park. The Night Traffic, Wrong Way and Drift Park rooms are always open: join with one click without creating a room. Chase, cockpit and hood cameras, a seven-station generative radio and weather options.

Night Drive is not a racing game. It is built for unwinding: an endless highway lit by sodium lamps, traffic to glide through and nothing to win but kilometres. Pick a car and a colour, turn on the radio and watch the road from the chase or the cockpit camera. Up to 16 friends share the same road, greet each other with a honk and score with distance and near misses. Every car and all traffic is simulated on the server, so everyone sees the same road.

Highlights
Four maps: Night City, Day City, Mountain Road (snowy, rainy, foggy, clear) and the Drift Park with drift scoring
Always-open Night Traffic, Wrong Way and Drift Park rooms: join with one click, no room setup
Up to 16 players on the same road, server-based online driving
5 car classes and 8 colours, each with its own speed, gearbox and grip
Chase, cockpit (first-person) and hood cameras; analogue speedometer and rev counter, moving gear lever and handbrake, rear-view mirror
Adjustable field of view (FOV), seat height and steering sensitivity; look around the cockpit with the mouse
Changing scenery: city, suburbs, forest, mountain tunnels, coastal bridges, an industrial port and wind-farm countryside
Same-direction and oncoming traffic; light / normal / heavy; clear or rainy night; optional wrong-way mode
Three lo-fi radio stations, rpm-driven engine sound, tunnel echo; gamepad support and tilt steering on mobile
How to play
Pick your car and colour in the lobby; the host sets the map (Night City, Day City, Mountain Road, Drift Park), weather, duration and traffic.
Gas, brake and steering: W/S and A/D or the arrow keys. On mobile use the on-screen buttons or tilt the phone.
On the highway and the mountain road, pass traffic closely without touching it: +25 points, with combos. On the mountain road you overtake in the oncoming lane.
On the drift park, tap the handbrake and slide on the gas: angle and speed grow the chain, hitting a wall burns it.
The Night Traffic, Wrong Way and Drift Park rooms are always open: join straight from the game page.
Controls

Desktop: W/↑ gas, S/↓ brake, A/D or ←/→ steer, Space handbrake, C camera, drag the mouse to look around in the cockpit, R radio, N station, L lights, H horn, O settings (FOV), G garage, M sound. Gamepads are supported. Mobile: bottom buttons or tilt the phone.

Tips & strategy
The left lane flows faster, but near misses come more often in the middle lane.
Chain passes for combos: a new near miss within 6 seconds raises the multiplier.
High beams reveal distant cars sooner; rain lowers grip and lengthens braking.
In wrong-way mode oncoming traffic slows and swerves for you, and near misses pay double. Stay calm.
Lost your friends? The ranking panel shows how many kilometres ahead they are.
Frequently asked questions
How many players can join Night Drive?

1 to 16. You can drive alone, and anyone joining the room later is added to the road.

Is the game server-based?

Yes. All cars, traffic and collisions are simulated on the server; the client only predicts and reconciles. Everyone sees the same traffic.

How is the winner decided?

By points: points per kilometre, near misses (+25 with combos), a smooth-flow bonus; bumps subtract points.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. Use the on-screen gas, brake and steering buttons or tilt the phone to steer.

How do I score on the drift park?

There is no traffic: tap the handbrake and slide on the gas, and your chain grows with angle and speed. Stop sliding to bank the points; long chains multiply up to ×5, and a hard wall hit burns the chain.

Is Night Drive free?

Yes. Night Drive is completely free and runs directly in your browser with no app to download.

Do I need an account to play?

No. Just pick a nickname and a mascot. An account is optional and keeps your progress, badges and friends list.

How do I play with friends?

Create a room, copy the invite link and send it to your friends. Night Drive is for 1–16 players.
